get.description: One JSON bundle representing this instance's config — diffable, git-committable, reproducible on a fresh instance via POST /v1/config/import. Excludes API keys (secrets to manage, not config) and WhatsApp pairing/auth state (session backup/restore handles that separately). Includes real secret values (webhook signing secret, proxy password) for round-trip fidelity — treat the exported file like a credentials file, the same as a .env.

post.description: Upserts webhook/rate-limit/proxy/browser-config per session (idempotent); rules are a full replace per session (existing rules for that session are deleted, then recreated from the bundle). Only applies to session ids already present in the bundle — it doesn't create/pair new WhatsApp sessions. A failure on one session is recorded in `errors` and doesn't abort the rest of the import.

200.description: Import result: sessions processed, and any per-session errors

enabled.description: true serves the Swagger UI at /api-docs, false hides it (404).

reset.description: true clears the saved choice so ENABLE_API_DOCS applies again. Ignored when `enabled` is given.

name.description: A label to recognize this key by (e.g. 'n8n workflow').

scope.description: read = GET endpoints only. send = read + all WhatsApp-facing actions (messages, chats, contacts, groups). admin = full access, including session/webhook/rate-limit config and key management.

displayName.description: This account's display name shown to contacts.

callType.description: Type of call the link opens.

startTime.description: When the call is scheduled to start (ISO 8601). Defaults to now.

packName.description: Sticker pack name shown in WhatsApp.

reaction.description: Emoji to react with. Send an empty string to remove an existing reaction.

chatId.description: Chat id (or bare phone number) to forward this message to.

duration.description: How long to keep the message pinned, in seconds. WhatsApp itself offers 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days; other values are accepted but the client may round them. Defaults to 7 days.

unmuteDate.description: ISO date to unmute at. Omit to mute indefinitely.

participants.description: Phone numbers (digits only, international format) to add as initial participants.
Phone numbers (digits only, international format) or full chat ids of the participants.

url.description: Media URL to post as a status. Provide this or `base64` + `mimetype`.

base64.description: Base64-encoded media data. Provide this + `mimetype`, or use `url` instead.

perMinute.description: Max sends per rolling 60s window. Pass null to revert to the instance default.

dailyCap.description: Max sends per UTC day. Pass null to revert to the instance default.

delayMinMs.description: Minimum randomized delay (ms) between queued sends. Pass null to revert to the instance default.

delayMaxMs.description: Maximum randomized delay (ms) between queued sends. Pass null to revert to the instance default.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the dashboard.

priority.description: Rules are evaluated in ascending priority order; the first match wins.

matchValue.description: Keyword/phrase or regex pattern. Required for type='keyword'/'regex', ignored otherwise.

chatScope.description: Which chats this rule applies to.

replyText.example: Thanks for reaching out — we'll get back to you during business hours.

rejectCall.description: For call/business-hours rules matched by an incoming call, reject the ringing call before sending the text.

cooldownMinutes.description: Minimum minutes between repeat firings of this rule for the same chat, to avoid spamming. 0 disables the cooldown.

businessHours.description: Required for type='business_hours'. { timezone: IANA name, days: [0-6] (0=Sun), startMinute, endMinute (minute-of-day, 0-1439), mode: 'outside' (OOO, default) | 'inside' }.

text.description: Sample incoming message text to evaluate against this session's rules.

chatType.description: Simulated chat type, for chatScope filtering.

username.description: Omit to leave existing credentials (if any) untouched. Pass null (together with password) to clear them, making the proxy unauthenticated.

password.description: Required together with username. Omit to leave unchanged; pass null to clear.

headless.description: Run Chromium headless. Pass null to revert to the instance default.

extraArgs.description: Extra raw Chromium launch flags (e.g. `--disable-gpu` for constrained ARM/Pi hardware), appended after the built-in ones. Pass null to revert to the instance default.

userAgent.description: Override the browser's User-Agent string. Pass null to revert to the instance default.

viewportWidth.description: Viewport width in px. Must be set together with viewportHeight. Pass null to revert to the instance default.

viewportHeight.description: Viewport height in px. Must be set together with viewportWidth. Pass null to revert to the instance default.

labelIds.description: The complete set of label ids this chat should have. This replaces the chat's current labels rather than adding to them — include ids that are already assigned if you want to keep them, and send an empty array to clear all labels.

listIds.description: Complete set of Rimberio list ids assigned to this chat

shortcut.description: Typed in the composer after a leading / to look this reply up. Stored and matched without the /.

message.example: Hi! Thanks for reaching out — how can I help?
Hi! Thanks for reaching out — how can I help?

url.description: URL this session's events are POSTed to.

events.description: Which events to deliver. Defaults to just `message` (incoming messages) if omitted.

secret.description: Shared secret used to HMAC-SHA256 sign the delivered payload (sent as the X-Rimberio-Signature header; X-Wapi-Signature is also sent for compatibility). Omit to send unsigned.

enabled.description: Enable or disable delivery without deleting the config.

exportedAt.description: Ignored by import — present so an unmodified export response can be POSTed straight back.

sessions.description: Map of session id -> that session's config bundle, as produced by GET /v1/config/export.
